name: 风云Ⅳ（2005 国内经典版）— fy2005
english_description: The same "Fengyun IV" engine as fengyun434, captured as a different year/site snapshot, with identical Gu Long-inspired wuxia gameplay of choosing an ethnic background and making one's way through jianghu sects. Notable for an ASCII-art CAPTCHA at registration — an unusually early anti-bot measure for this engine family — and for only persisting characters who reach at least 40% experience toward level 2. Active upstream adds MXP/GMCP client protocol support.
